missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'План' is masculine nominative as the subject in this possession frame. 'Хороший' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'План' is the masculine inanimate accusative, identical to the nominative. It is the direct object of 'составили'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Плана' is the masculine genitive showing what the part belongs to. It modifies 'часть'.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Плану' is the dative form after 'следуем', which governs the dative. 'Своему' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Dative in an idiom. 'Плану' is the dative form in 'по плану', meaning according to plan. A very common everyday expression.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В плане' uses the prepositional form 'плане' after 'в' to locate the error within the plan.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О плане' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Своём' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: У него большие планы на лето.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Планы' is the masculine nominative plural as the subject. 'Большие' agrees in the plural, naming summer plans.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Плана' is the masculine genitive after 'без'. 'Чёткого' agrees in the masculine genitive.

missions.phrase: Какой у тебя план на сегодня?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'План' is masculine nominative in this possession frame. 'Какой' agrees in the masculine, asking about today's plan.
